name: Sreeleela
bio:
Sreeleela (born June 14, 2001) is an American actress of Indian origin and classical dancer who predominantly works in Telugu cinema.

She made her acting debut in the Kannada film *Kiss* (2019), followed by *Bharaate* (2019). She entered Telugu cinema with the musical romance *Pelli SandaD* (2021) and appeared alongside Ravi Teja in *Dhamaka* (2022). She has also appeared in *Bhagavanth Kesari* (2023), *Guntur Kaaram* (2024), *Robinhood* (2025), and *Junior* (2025), and made a special dance appearance in *Pushpa 2: The Rule* (2024).

Her performances have earned her three South Indian International Movie Awards (SIIMA), including Best Female Debut – Kannada (*Kiss*), Most Promising Newcomer – Female (*Pelli SandaD*), and Best Actress – Telugu (*Dhamaka*), as well as a nomination for the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress – Telugu for *Bhagavanth Kesari*.
